title: iSawIt - BCI
_comment: Generated by build_config.py from the BCI CSVs (Barro Colorado Island, Panama). Scientific names only (prototype). 'n' = display name. taxa = Quick list; taxaFull = optional full checklist. Insects: Quick holds only the first 50 species as a test; the full list (all species in the CSV) is in taxaFull and selectable at session start.
